description: "Taken by the Enemy" by Oliver Optic is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. The narrative centers on Captain Horatio Passford, the owner of a steam-yacht named Bellevite, who is thrown into turmoil upon learning of the outbreak of the Civil War.
